title: France Visit Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Documents, Fees & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: France visit visa from Pakistan (Schengen): requirements, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, common mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: France tourist visa from Pakistan — documents?
faqs.answer: Passport, form, insurance, funds, accommodation, employment ties and itinerary. SK prepares the complete pack.

faqs.question: Family invitation France?
faqs.answer: Host attestation / accommodation proof helps. Still need your own funds and return ties.

faqs.question: Business visit France?
faqs.answer: Need inviting company letter and your employer letter explaining meetings — not employment in France.

faqs.question: Refusal reasons?
faqs.answer: Insufficient ties, unclear purpose, weak funds, or inconsistent travel history are common.

France visit visa from Pakistan

SK Immigration Services helps Pakistani applicants prepare France visit visa files for tourism, family, short business. Embassies decide outcomes — we prepare complete, honest applications.

Who this page is for

Candidates searching for France visit visa requirements from Pakistan, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, refusal reasons and how to apply — with SK Immigration as their consultant in Rawalpindi.

Requirements

  • Valid passport and Schengen application
  • Travel insurance €30,000+
  • Accommodation proof (hotel or host attestation)
  • Funds and employment/business evidence
  • Itinerary matching France as main destination when applying via France

Process — how to apply

  1. Confirm main destination / first entry logic
  2. Host letter or hotel plan
  3. Financial and employment file
  4. TLS/VFS appointment prep
  5. Biometrics

Documents checklist

  • Passport, photos, form
  • Insurance
  • Invitation / hotel bookings
  • Bank statements
  • Leave letter / business registration
  • Family registry if visiting relatives

Fees

SK from PKR 30,000. Consular/VFS fees separate.

Processing time / timeline

Often 2–8 weeks seasonally.

Common mistakes & refusal risks

  • Applying via wrong Schengen country
  • Hotel bookings that do not match itinerary
  • Unexplained large cash deposits
  • Weak cover letter

Related services

All visit visas · Work permits · Visa appointments · Study visas · Free consultation

France visit visa from Pakistan — AEG appointments and attestation d'accueil

France Schengen visits from Pakistan require France-Visas forms, compliant insurance and often AEG appointment channels. Family stays frequently need attestation d'accueil from French hosts.

Where Pakistanis apply (France)

Ordinary-passport France visa appointments in Pakistan are booked through AEG Travel Services after France-Visas submission.

Centres: AEG Islamabad-linked process — follow Embassy of France Pakistan instructions. Confirm the live centre list before paying travel costs to a VAC city.

Tourism visits

Paris/regional plans with hotels or lawful host paperwork; day-by-day itinerary matching insurance dates.

Family visits

Attestation d'accueil from French mairie for hosted stays; still need Pakistani ties.

Business visitor (short meetings)

Company invitations with meeting schedules — not employment offers on visit status.

Pakistan-side refusal risks

  • Missing attestation d'accueil for family stays
  • AEG slot without complete insurance
  • Main destination actually Italy/Spain
  • Sudden bank deposits before apply

Funds and credibility

Many planners use ~€65/day with prepaid hotel or higher without — confirm France-Visas subsistence guidance; match PKR history to trip.

Visit vs study / work

Short visits cannot replace student residence or work permits. For degrees see France study visa. Work needs correct authorization — work permit hub.

Official France links · France visit checklist · refusal reasons · appointment guides

Cover letter outline (France visit from Pakistan)

  1. Your role in Pakistan (job, business, study) with contactable employer
  2. Exact travel dates aligned with insurance and hotel/invite
  3. Day-level plan for France cities — not a generic “Europe tour”
  4. Who pays, with six-month bank trail explaining any large deposits
  5. Why you return (dependents, property, business continuity, studies)
  6. Prior visas/refusals stated calmly with what changed

First-time travellers from Pakistan

No prior visas is not automatic refusal, but first files need clearer employment proof and realistic trip length. Prior compliant Schengen/UK/US travel helps when explained; unexplained gaps hurt.

Children and family groups

Carry birth certificates and school leave letters. Group itineraries must show every traveller’s ties — not only the primary applicant’s job letter.

After a refusal

Read the refusal letter themes before reapplying. Fixing only the appointment slot without stronger purpose, funds or ties usually fails again. See visit refusal reasons and what next.
